# Chlorine bags: All locations with map

![Chlorine bags: All locations with map](/uploads/638_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

In the **Mini Season "Love Hurts"** one of the challenges is to collect **chlorine bags**. There may be challenges in the future that require this. Therefore, in this article you will find all the locations and a map to help you find the chlorine bags in Fallout 76.

Also remember that you shouldn't have the chlorine bags in your loot list so that they spawn for you: Item respawn explained (loot list)

## Chlorine bags locations

- 6x Silva Manor
- 4x Ash Caves
- 3x Aaronhold Estate
- 2x Athens
- 2x Radiant Hills
- 2x Harpers Ferry Tunnels
- 2x viewing hut
- 2x north of New Gad
- 1x Rust Kingdom
- 1x Black Bear Lodge
- 1x Grafton Steel
- 1x south of Camden Park
- 1x Garrahan Estate
- 1x Flatwoods
- 1x Vault-Tec agricultural center

See gallery below.

## Chlorine bags in instances

- 3x Enclave Research Facility
- 2x Arktor Pharma biolaboratory
- 2x Fort Defiance
- 1x Top of the World (mezzanine)
- 1x Blackwater mine
- 1x Vault 79
- 1x Watoga underground

## Chlorine bags map

On this map you will find all the **chlorine bags** as well as the other items for the mini season "Love hurts" (from February 3rd, 2026).

*click to zoom*

![Mini Season: Love Hurts (Challenges Map)](/uploads/nukaknights-post-miniseason-lovehurts-map-tips-1920.jpg) 

**Poisonous Sooty Flower**,

**brain fungus**,

**carrot flower**,

**Fire Hat**and

**chlorine bags**
